shared_elements: human figures in profile with arms raised toward a central motif
symmetrical composition flanking a central axis
register of dense script/sign-like inscription along the bottom
low-relief flat figures with outline-defined limbs
justification: Both show a bilaterally symmetrical scene in which figures on either side face and raise their arms toward a central axis element (a rayed disc with cartouches in A; a stylized sacred tree/plant in B), with a horizontal band of script filling the lower portion of the field. But the specific figures differ entirely — slender human family groups with elongated skulls and long pleated garments in A versus heavy winged/animal-headed muscular beings with palmette motifs in B — and A's arched field with radiating hands-ended rays has no counterpart in B.
